name: xlsx_read
description: Read an Excel .xlsx workbook and return each sheet as rows of values (numbers, text, booleans; formulas as their last calculated value). Charts, images and styles are ignored.

sheet.description: read only this sheet (default: all sheets)

max_rows.description: rows to return per sheet (default 200); row_count tells the real size

sheets.description: [{name, rows: [[value]] from column A, row_count, truncated}]
